definitions.explanation: The number eighteen. Formed by combining {十|じゅう} (ten) and {八|はち} (eight).

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{十八|じゅうはち}{歳|さい}で{選挙|せんきょ}ができます。
examples.english: In Japan, you can vote at eighteen years old.

examples.japanese: {十八|じゅうはち}{番|ばん}を{選|えら}んでください。
{部屋|へや}は{十八|じゅうはち}{畳|じょう}あります。
examples.english: The room is eighteen tatami mats in size.

notes: Eighteen is the legal voting age in Japan (changed from 20 in 2016). The legal drinking and smoking age remains 20.
